responsibility: Implements the rs6000 machine-description support for paired-single floating-point instructions on targets with TARGET_PAIRED_FLOAT. It defines RTL patterns and expanders for V2SF arithmetic, reciprocal, sqrt, fused multiply-add/subtract variants, merge/extract-style operations, reductions, vector initialization and misaligned moves, and conditional selection, forming the backend instruction-selection layer that lowers paired builtins and vector operations to ps_* instructions.
same_name_distinction: Unlike paired.h, this is the backend machine-description file for paired-single support: it defines TARGET_PAIRED_FLOAT RTL patterns, expands, and instruction selection for ps_* operations, rather than the user-visible intrinsic macros and type aliases.
